flags.text: No source text was supplied for §1692g, Regulation F or the Rosenthal Act. Citation names alone do not support the claims.
“Must send” states an unqualified notice duty. The dispute sentence could also be read as a cutoff for all disputes, without identifying what depends on timing or writing.
A reader who missed 30 days might conclude there is no point in questioning the debt.
The different-company condition does not identify which company is the original creditor or why the debt’s history matters to coverage.
“Keep copies of everything” is a direct instruction.

result.summary: No claim can be verified from the supplied materials. The notice duty, dispute deadline and creditor coverage remain unchecked.
